summary.headline: Binance snapshot PR12NOV26 provides public reserve summary and wallet_address_list where available, but Stage 1 is blocked by missing wallet_ownership_proof, opaque trusted setup, and unavailable public global proof/vk artifacts.
summary.rationale: The available artifacts support Gen 2 / E2 classification and Stage 0 PoR disclosure. Users still need to trust Binance for wallet control, trusted setup honesty, and public availability of the full global proof stack.
